notes: Gambrel roof with ridge east-west; storey 3 is the gambrel storey (gable-end windows west and east, a wide gambrel dormer centred on the south). Ground floor sills ~6.5 ft over the ground: raised basement, floor ~3.5 ft. South: storey 1 from 0.45 to 0.75 is a smear (probably a porch or entry, not readable), the right end 0.75-1.0 shows plain wall; storey 3 dormer has a paired window. West: side door at 0.71 at grade with a hood, and a stair-landing window above it between storeys 1 and 2 (put on storey 2). East: left third (0-0.3) hidden by a tree; windows at 0.72 and 0.82 may be on a shallow bay. North: almost all hidden by a tree; only two storey-2 windows at 0.37 and 0.50 are visible, storeys 1 and 3 unreadable.
